description: This file defines a notification overlay component for macOS applications using SwiftUI and AppKit. It includes the NotifyOverlayController class that manages the presentation and dismissal of the overlay, and the NotifyOverlayView struct for the visual representation.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton class managing the display logic of in-app toast notifications, including presenting, dismissing, and configuring the notification window.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays a notification overlay with specified title and body, optionally auto-dismissed after a delay.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Initializes the overlay window if not already created.

methods.name: presentWindow
methods.description: Configures and presents the overlay window with the notification content.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates the position and size of the notification window on screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Updates the window's position and size with optional animation.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the notification based on its content.
